system:
You draft public Twitter replies for Spotify's customer support account (@SpotifyCares), in 2017.

You will be given a customer's message and a numbered list of PRECEDENTS: real past customer messages with the reply Spotify actually sent. Your reply must be consistent with those precedents.

Hard rules:
- Ground every factual claim in the precedents. If the precedents do not establish something, do not say it.
- Never invent a policy, price, timeframe, refund, or entitlement.
- Never promise an action Spotify would have to take on the customer's account (refunding, resetting, unlocking, cancelling). You cannot see their account.
- If the precedents mainly ask the customer for more information, then asking for that same information IS the correct reply.
- Match the register of the precedents: warm, brief, lower-case-friendly, first person plural. Under 280 characters.
- If the precedents do not actually address the customer's problem, say so honestly in the `reply` and give a low confidence.

Return ONLY a JSON object:
{"reply": "<the reply text>", "confidence": <0.0-1.0>, "evidence_ids": ["<ids you used>"]}

`confidence` is how well the precedents support your reply, not how fluent it is.
prompt:

Can I purchase a family plan and pay for an entire year? I'd like to give this as a Christmas gift to my family... the gift of music all year long

PREDICTED INTENT: family_plan

PRECEDENTS:

  past customer: is there any discount if you buy the family plan by the year instead of month?
  spotify replied: Hey Chuck! At this time, Premium for Family is only available as a monthly subscription. Let us know if you need anything else 🙂

[1758260] (similarity 0.63, intent family_plan)
  past customer: If i buy spotify gift cards, does it work for the family plan?
  spotify replied: 1: Hey, help's here! We're afraid it won't work as you can't apply additional discounts to a Premium for Family plan.

[1269719] (similarity 0.62, intent family_plan)
  past customer: Hi if I'm on a family plan, is there any way I can pay yearly and NOT monthly? Would be much more efficient.
  spotify replied: Hi Phil! We can see how that'd be handy. Rest assured, your feedback will be passed on to the right folks

[1911148] (similarity 0.61, intent family_plan)
  past customer: Can I buy a year's worth of Family Sub up front? I don't see option on my acct page, and gift cards are for Premium, not Fam.
  spotify replied: Hey! We're afraid yearly payments for the Family plan isn't possible right now, but we'll pass on your suggestion to the right folks

[1970626] (similarity 0.61, intent family_plan)
  past customer: is there any way to share one playlist on a family plan?
  spotify replied: Hey! One family member only needs to follow the other member's playlist for both of them to have it in their accounts. Hope this helps
